title: Sereja and Contest
statementMd:
During the last Sereja's Codesecrof round the server crashed many times, so the round was decided to be made unrated for some participants.

Let's assume that $*n*$ people took part in the contest. Let's assume that the participant who got the first place has rating $*a*_{1}$, the second place participant has rating $*a*_{2}$, $...$, the $*n*$-th place participant has rating $*a*_{*n*}$. Then changing the rating on the Codesecrof site is calculated by the formula ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f678d203a355b3143ff0f021474100fef62b1b8f.png).

After the round was over, the Codesecrof management published the participants' results table. They decided that if for a participant $*d*_{*i*} < *k*$, then the round can be considered unrated for him. But imagine the management's surprise when they found out that the participants' rating table is dynamic. In other words, when some participant is removed from the rating, he is removed from the results' table and the rating is recalculated according to the new table. And of course, all applications for exclusion from the rating are considered in view of the current table.

We know that among all the applications for exclusion from the rating the first application to consider is from the participant with the best rank (the rank with the minimum number), for who $*d*_{*i*} < *k*$. We also know that the applications for exclusion from rating were submitted by all participants.

Now Sereja wonders, what is the number of participants to be excluded from the contest rating, and the numbers of the participants in the original table in the order of their exclusion from the rating. Pay attention to the analysis of the first test case for a better understanding of the statement.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$, $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5},  - 10^{9} ≤ *k* ≤ 0)$. The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ — ratings of the participants in the initial table.

## Output

Print the numbers of participants in the order in which they were removed from the table. Print the initial numbers of the participants, that is, the numbers that the participants had in the initial table.

## Note

Consider the first test sample.

1. Initially the sequence of the contest participants' ratings equals [5, 3, 4, 1, 2]. You can use this sequence to calculate the sequence of rating changes: [0, -9, -13, 8, 14]. According to the problem statement, the application of the participant who won the second place will be considered first.
2. As soon as the second place winner is out from the ratings, the participants' rating sequence will equal [5, 4, 1, 2]. By this sequence you can count the new sequence of rating changes: [0, -8, 2, 6]. According to the problem statement, the application of the participant who won the second place will be considered. Initially this participant won third place.
3. The new rating sequence equals [5, 1, 2], the new sequence of rating changes equals [0, -1, 1]. The second place participant's application is taken into consideration, initially this participant won the fourth place.
4. The new rating sequence equals [5, 2], the new sequence of rating changes equals [0, 0]. No more applications will be considered.

Thus, you should print 2, 3, 4.
statementZhMd:
在上一次 Sereja 的 Codesecrof 比赛中，服务器多次崩溃，因此决定对部分参赛者将本场比赛设为不计分。

假设有 $*n*$ 个人参加比赛。排名第一的参赛者 rating 为 $*a*_{1}$，排名第二的参赛者 rating 为 $*a*_{2}$，$...$，排名第 $*n*$ 的参赛者 rating 为 $*a*_{*n*}$。那么，Codesecrof 网站上 rating 的变化将按照公式 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f678d203a355b3143ff0f021474100fef62b1b8f.png) 计算。

比赛结束后，Codesecrof 管理方公布了参赛者的成绩表。他们决定，如果某位参赛者满足 $*d*_{*i*} < *k*$，则可以认为这场比赛对该参赛者不计分。然而，管理方惊讶地发现，参赛者的 rating 表是动态变化的。换句话说，当某位参赛者被移出 rating 计算时，他也会从成绩表中移除，rating 将根据新的成绩表重新计算。当然，所有关于移出 rating 的申请都将依据当前的成绩表进行处理。

我们知道，在所有移出 rating 的申请中，最先处理的是排名最靠前（排名数字最小）且满足 $*d*_{*i*} < *k*$ 的参赛者的申请。我们还知道，所有参赛者都提交了移出 rating 的申请。

现在 Sereja 想知道，最终有多少名参赛者会被移出比赛 rating，以及这些参赛者在原始成绩表中的编号，并按他们被移出 rating 的顺序输出。为了更好地理解题意，请注意第一组测试数据的分析。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5},  - 10^{9} ≤ *k* ≤ 0)$。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*a*_{2}$、$...$、$*a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$，表示初始成绩表中参赛者的 rating。

## 输出格式

按照参赛者从成绩表中被移除的顺序，输出他们的编号。输出参赛者的初始编号，即他们在初始成绩表中的编号。

## 说明

考虑第一组测试数据。

1. 初始时，参赛者 rating 序列为 [5, 3, 4, 1, 2]。根据该序列可以计算出 rating 变化序列：[0, -9, -13, 8, 14]。根据题意，排名第二的参赛者的申请将最先被处理。
2. 当排名第二的参赛者被移出 rating 计算后，参赛者 rating 序列变为 [5, 4, 1, 2]。根据该序列可以计算出新的 rating 变化序列：[0, -8, 2, 6]。根据题意，排名第二的参赛者的申请将被处理。该参赛者在初始成绩表中的排名是第三。
3. 新的 rating 序列为 [5, 1, 2]，新的 rating 变化序列为 [0, -1, 1]。排名第二的参赛者的申请被处理，该参赛者在初始成绩表中的排名是第四。
4. 新的 rating 序列为 [5, 2]，新的 rating 变化序列为 [0, 0]。不再处理其他申请。

因此，应输出 2、3、4。
